desc: The most items your kitchen can turn out at once, across all the categories you’ve checked. Each category’s own batch size still applies on top.
example: Example: if you can cook 4 entrées in 5 minutes, then set it to 4 items every 5 minutes. The total capacity limits orders across all selected categories so if you want to only sell a maximum of 10 appetizers and entrées every 5 minutes, then set Total capacity to 10 items every 5 minutes and check the Appetizers and Entrées boxes. This will still keep your entrées restricted to 4 items every 5 minutes.
noVan: Add a truck in Settings › Truck settings to set your kitchen capacity.
lead: How many items your kitchen can make, so customers can only choose pickup times you can meet.
sameForAll: Same kitchen capacity for all trucks?
confirmBody: All trucks will use {van}’s kitchen capacity. Each truck’s own numbers will be replaced.
colCountsTitle: Which categories count toward the total capacity. Cooked categories always count; check instant ones (sides, dips, drinks) to include them.
countsTick: Check to include this instant category (sides, dips, drinks) in the shared per-window limit
